hypotheses.X0_alignment_is_adjudicative: For at least one of Layers 1-3, the global source-to-target activation map has held-out state R2 >= 0.50 in every ordered model pair.
hypotheses.X1_semantic_computation_is_cross_seed_re: At an adjudicative Layer 1 or 2, same-rule mapped edits have mean target-effect fidelity >=0.50 and target accuracy no more than 0.15 below the target model's own semantic edit.
hypotheses.X2_same_rule_beats_wrong_rule: At an adjudicative Layer 1 or 2, the same-rule mapped edit exceeds a norm-matched wrong-rule edit by >=0.20 effect fidelity or >=0.15 target accuracy.
hypotheses.X3_semantics_adds_more_than_source_answe: At an adjudicative Layer 1 or 2, mapped semantic edits exceed mapped generic source-answer edits by >=0.10 effect fidelity.
hypotheses.X4_final_layer_is_a_shared_output_interf: At adjudicative Layer 3, mapped generic source-answer edits are within 0.10 effect fidelity of mapped semantic edits, while mapped semantic fidelity is >=0.70.
